title: American's Network Chief Exits, Saudi Arabia Evacuates $4 Billion in Jets, and Ryanair's $9 Flight Sale
summary: American's network boss is out as the airline tries to walk back years of retreat — and we talk fleet with the exec who's replacing his vision. Plus, Saudi airlines scramble to evacuate billions in aircraft from Riyadh, Southwest flirts with widebodies, and United's stuck holding hundreds of lie-flat seats with nowhere to put them.
